scope: Read-only sufficiency review of new test lifetime helper; no execution or source changes
decision: Existing14capture+4service+7semantic mutants do not establish helper timeout/failure lifecycle; require a small isolated behavior gate
reason: Existing test budgets are upper failure guards; passing tests do not trigger node:test timeout. Semantic policy mutants cause ordinary body assertions/errors, not necessarily delayed body cancellation, rejected shutdown or unconfirmed child disposal.

The helper is responsible for trustworthiness of test evidence. Its late completion and retained-file guarantees materially matter when tests fail; source review alone is insufficient for these new branches.

requiredGate.execution: Use actual nested node:test in a disposable subprocess so intentional failures/timeouts do not become skips or poison the parent suite. Outer test asserts exact expected failure diagnostics/exit, real filesystem state and event order. Bound watchdog owns only its own process tree and retains evidence on failure.

cases.behavior: Deliberately timeout a real node:test while owner.invoke work and an actually spawned child are active; cancellation reaches body, registered runtime stop is awaited, and genuine child close occurs before root deletion. Hold cancellation completion/child exit via real IPC/file barrier so ordering is observable rather than inferred from elapsed time.
cases.oracles: Parent observes root still present while any body/stop/child remains unsettled; after release observes all settled and root removed. Expected node:test timeout remains reported as failure, never converted into success. No unhandled rejection or uncaught teardown exception.

cases.behavior: Registered runtime stop rejects while body is settling/rejecting; exercise immediate rejection observation and error propagation.
cases.oracles: Root retained with exact CLUSTER_TEST_FILES_RETAINED -> CLUSTER_TEST_SHUTDOWN_FAILED cause chain; body rejection remains reported; no unhandled rejection; outer harness explicitly settles/owns any child before cleanup.

cases.behavior: Actual child or body remains unsettled beyond the existing10000ms disposal deadline, then completes after failure is recorded.
cases.oracles: Root retained at disposal failure and remains retained after late completion; exact CLUSTER_TEST_DISPOSAL_UNCONFIRMED cause; no delayed rm and no unhandled rejection. Keep original helper timeout rather than injecting shorter production/test-helper constant; outer harness must release and observe real child close before its own cleanup.

notRequired: Do not create mirror tests for every helper line, every scalar setting or every combination of start/stop.
No need to rerun unrelated heavy scopes merely to prove helper mechanics; execute bounded ownership gate plus actual CI2 positive/control suites after integration.
No claim about production process ownership follows from a test-helper lifecycle gate.
existingCoverageRetained: Full14capture+4production routes and7semantic controls remain required; lifecycle gate supplements them and cannot replace CI2/RS2 behavior.
